preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(x) <= n for x in stdin.split() if x.isdigit()) and len(stdin.split()) == m * 2 + 3
preconditions.description: Input consists of exactly n, m, k (1 ≤ n ≤ 2·10^5, n-1 ≤ m ≤ 2·10^5, 1 ≤ k ≤ n) followed by m lines of two integers each (1 ≤ xi, yi ≤ n) representing edges. The graph is connected.

preconditions.expression: n >= 1 and m >= n - 1 and k >= 1 and k <= n
preconditions.description: Graph has at least one vertex, at least n-1 edges (ensuring connectivity), and at least one clone but no more than the number of vertices.

postconditions.expression: all(len(line.split()) >= 1 for line in stdout.splitlines()) and len(stdout.splitlines()) == k
postconditions.description: Output consists of exactly k lines, each representing a clone's route.

postconditions.expression: all(all(1 <= int(v) <= n for v in line.split()[1:]) for line in stdout.splitlines())
postconditions.description: Every vertex in every clone's route is a valid vertex index (1 ≤ v ≤ n).
Each clone's route contains at most 6 vertices (as per the first sample's constraint).

postconditions.expression: all(line.split()[0] == str(len(line.split()[1:])) for line in stdout.splitlines())
postconditions.description: The first number in each line is exactly the count of vertices visited by that clone.

postconditions.expression: all(any(v == line.split()[1] for line in stdout.splitlines() if v in line.split()[1:]) for v in range(1, n + 1))
postconditions.description: Every vertex from 1 to n is visited by at least one clone (exit condition).

postconditions.expression: all(line.split()[1] in line.split()[2:] for line in stdout.splitlines())
postconditions.description: Each clone's route starts and ends at the same vertex (must visit starting vertex at least once).
